about.heading: A Security Partner Built on Discipline and Trust
about.intro: Jyothi Security Services (JSS) is a professional security agency providing trained and verified guards to schools, hospitals, industries, corporate offices, apartments and institutions. We combine disciplined manpower with structured supervision so that every client site is protected around the clock.
about.missionText: To deliver reliable, professional and affordable security services that protect people, property and businesses through well-trained and disciplined personnel.
about.visionText: To be the most trusted security services provider in Karnataka, recognised for integrity, discipline and consistent quality of service.

discipline.title: Discipline
discipline.description: Every guard follows structured protocols, reporting lines and uniform standards without exception.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.description: We operate with honesty and transparency in every client relationship and every deployment.

trust.title: Trust
trust.description: Background-oriented screening and consistent supervision build lasting client confidence.

customerSatisfaction.description: We measure success by how safe and supported our clients feel, every single day.

history.heading: Our History
history.intro: JSS has grown step by step, guided by discipline and the trust our clients place in us. This timeline is a general overview of that journey; exact dates and figures will be updated with the company's official records.

foundation.title: Company Started
foundation.description: JSS was founded with a small, disciplined team of guards serving local businesses in and around Kolar.

growth.title: Growth Journey
growth.description: Steady referrals and consistent service helped us grow our guard strength and supervisory structure.

expansion.title: Expansion
expansion.description: We expanded coverage to additional towns and took on larger institutional clients.

diversification.title: Industries Served
diversification.description: Our services broadened to cover schools, hospitals, factories, warehouses and corporate offices.

today.title: Current Position
today.description: Today, JSS supports a wide range of clients with trained guards, structured attendance and dedicated support.

future.title: Future Goals
future.description: We aim to deepen training standards, expand into new regions, and adopt better technology for client reporting.
